three_camera_display_check_bounds.scope: 8-bit preview rerender only; every mismatch retained. No bound on restoration/metric/color errors.

artifact_integrity.limitations: Integrity and declared display-rounding checks, not actual visual inspection or quality. Real GFX/RawNIND references are not exact GT; photographic synthetic targets are exact for that synthetic observation only.

notes.full427: Both erase fine paraglider cords present in exact GT; building geometry survives while facade detail and cloud wisps soften. No clear visual arm gain in the two fixed sources.
notes.known: Both smooth fine plate bands and simplify bright reflections; the 7D panel borders and small white point remain with soft edges. No clear arm difference. Independently AHD demosaiced reference is not exact RGB GT.
notes.unseen: Apple and tan/red surfaces retain broad shading but little fine texture. No clear arm difference. Independently AHD demosaiced reference is not exact RGB GT.
notes.analytic: Both almost erase the dark carrier; the brighter weak grating remains faint and attenuated. The neutral field is smooth with mild broad variation. No visible expanded-data advantage.
notes.gfx: Both remove sky noise but soften truss openings, leaf edges/veins and wire crossings. Coarse mesh remains. No clear arm detail advantage. DSCF3880 ISO100 f/5.6 is an independent qualitative reference, not GT.
notes.three-camera: Q2 dark rock texture remains similarly soft in both arms and RawNIND. Sony window geometry survives but edges remain soft. Both retain more GF50R concrete texture than RawNIND, with residual grain; no clear difference between data arms. RawNIND is a comparator, not GT.
notes.colored-CPU: Neutral and cyan fields are smooth. Warm and magenta fields show broad mottling and small color shifts. Both arms look similar; no general color repair.
notes.prospective-grid: Both neutral fields are smooth. Orange is close with mild broad variation. Magenta shows visible mottling/color shift in both. V64 improves the numerical highly saturated bright grid bias against V63, but does not remove it; retained V60/reference PNGs reuse verified previous views.

limitations: One matched training seed. Source bootstrap intervals measure evaluation-source variation, not training or model-selection uncertainty.
V60 parent comparisons include additional training and fresh optimizer/EMA; only V64-vs-V63 isolates declared manifest membership at this boundary.
All original V63/V64 schedules remain planned20000/frozen4000. No convergence or universally useless-data conclusion.
Photographic exact GT is synthetic at the 8x-binned evaluation resolution; paired RGB is independently demosaiced. GFX low-ISO and RawNIND panels are not exact GT.
Fixed color/analytic diagnostics were motivated by prior failures and are not blind natural-photo evidence. One color-grid draw per CFA/condition.
Full 101.996MP RGB16 files exist; measured shared-machine inference35.91/37.31s does not meet10s. CUDA allocation is not total unified RAM.
Protected-final model scores remain unused. SOTA and the requested large qualitative gain remain unproven.
